title: Maximum EMF formula
description: Essential: Student must correctly state or apply the formula for maximum induced EMF in a rotating coil: E_m = NBSω.

title: Correct numerical substitution
description: Essential: Student must correctly substitute all given values (N=100, B=0.10 T, S=0.10 m², ω=100π rad/s) into the formula.

title: Final answer with units
description: Essential: Student must provide the final numerical answer of approximately 314 V (or 100π V) with correct voltage units.

title: Physics reasoning
description: Important: Student should recognize that maximum EMF occurs when the coil's plane is parallel to the magnetic field, making the rate of flux change maximal.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student may verify unit consistency (T·m²·rad/s = V) to confirm the dimensional correctness of their calculation.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Using E = -N dΦ/dt without evaluating the maximum, or confusing it with motional EMF formula for linear motion.

title: Calculation or unit error
description: Pitfall: Making arithmetic mistakes in multiplication, mishandling π, or omitting/incorrectly using units in the final answer.
